name: MMAG
recent: MMAG 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日召开特别股东大会，通过最多 1.3 亿令吉的股本削减议案；此前公司于 10 月 19 日宣布间接子公司 MJets Air 以 280 万美元出售一架 Boeing B737-400SF 飞机。11 月中旬，公司宣布银行账户已解除反洗钱法令限制。
notable: 间接子公司 MJets Air 与 Mont Gabanon Airlines 签署飞机购买协议，以 280 万美元现金出售一架 Boeing B737-400SF 飞机。
股东在特别股东大会通过最多 1.3 亿令吉的已发行股本削减议案。
公司宣布银行账户已解除反洗钱法令限制。
risks: 法庭审理涉及公司被指策划撤换 M Jets 董事的指控。
公司此前银行账户曾受反洗钱法令限制，现已解除。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 1.661 亿令吉，环比增长 0.1%，同比下滑 26.6%；净亏损 942 万令吉，净利率为 -5.7%，较去年同期的 -67.4% 有所收窄，但净亏损同比扩大 165.7%。

recent_en: MMAG held an EGM on 5 Nov 2026 where shareholders approved a capital reduction of up to RM130 million; earlier, indirect subsidiary MJets Air agreed on 19 Oct 2026 to dispose a Boeing B737-400SF aircraft for USD2.8 million. In mid-November, the company announced that AMLA restrictions on its bank accounts had been lifted.
notable_en: Indirect subsidiary MJets Air signed an aircraft purchase agreement with Mont Gabanon Airlines to dispose a Boeing B737-400SF aircraft for USD2.8 million cash.
Shareholders passed a proposed reduction of up to RM130 million of the issued share capital at an EGM.
The company announced that AMLA restrictions on its bank accounts had been lifted.
risks_en: Court hearings involve allegations that the company plotted to oust M Jets directors.
The company's bank accounts were previously subject to AMLA restrictions, which have now been lifted.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM166.1 million, up 0.1% QoQ but down 26.6% YoY; net loss was RM9.4 million with a net margin of -5.7%, improved from -67.4% a year earlier, while net loss widened 165.7% YoY.
